title: Request for Information (RFI)
markdown:
In Collaborate, members can submit Requests for Information (RFIs), facilitating the exchange of insights for optimizing their organization's security posture. For more information, see [Collaborate Request for Information Documentation](https://techdocs.cyware.com/csap/en/request-for-information--rfi-.html).

As a member, you can perform the following actions:

*   Submit a new RFI to request specific information from members or external sources.
    
*   Provide a response to an open RFI, contributing valuable insights or data.
    
*   Attach relevant files or documents to an RFI response for further clarity and support.
